tools.description:
Creates a new Google Ads asset under the specified customer account.

Required & Optional parameters per `asset_type`:
- **TEXT**: Requires `text_asset_text`.
- **IMAGE**: Requires either `image_asset_path` (absolute local path, local stdio mode only)
  OR `image_asset_data` (base64 encoded string). If `image_asset_data` is provided,
  `image_asset_mime_type` is also required (e.g. 'IMAGE_PNG', 'IMAGE_JPEG', 'IMAGE_GIF').
- **YOUTUBE_VIDEO**: Requires `youtube_video_id`.
- **SITELINK**: Requires `sitelink_link_text` and root-level `final_urls`.
  Accepts optional `sitelink_description1` and `sitelink_description2`.
- **CALLOUT**: Requires `callout_text`.
- **STRUCTURED_SNIPPET**: Requires `structured_snippet_header` and `structured_snippet_values`.

Root-level URL and tracking configurations (optional except where noted):
- `name`: Optional display name for the asset.
- `final_urls`: Required for SITELINK. A list of URLs.
- `final_mobile_urls`: List of mobile-specific destination URLs.
- `tracking_url_template`: Template for constructing a tracking URL.
- `final_url_suffix`: Suffix appended to the final URL.
- `url_custom_parameters`: Custom parameters represented as a list of dicts (with 'key' and 'value').

For any other asset type, provide `extra_params` as a dict representing the sub-asset message fields.

Propose & Confirm Workflow (`validate_only` and `checksum`):
1. Call `create_asset` with `validate_only=True` (the default). After validation passes, the tool returns structured `change_items` and a `checksum` without committing changes.
2. Present the `change_items` to the user and wait for explicit user approval.
3. Only after user confirmation, call `create_asset` with `validate_only=False` along with the exact same parameters and the `checksum` returned by the previous `validate_only=True` call.

callout_text.description: Optional callout text (required for CALLOUT type).

checksum.description: Checksum of the validated operation returned by a prior `validate_only=True` call. Required when `validate_only=False`.

customer_id.description: Google Ads Customer ID (digits or hyphenated, e.g. '1234567890').

extra_params.description: Optional dict representing nested parameters for less common asset types.

final_mobile_urls.description: Optional list of final mobile URLs.

final_urls.description: Optional list of final URLs (required for SITELINK).

image_asset_data.description: Optional base64 encoded image data (supported for IMAGE type).

image_asset_mime_type.description: Optional MIME type (e.g., 'IMAGE_PNG', 'IMAGE_JPEG', 'IMAGE_GIF'; required if image_asset_data is used).

image_asset_path.description: Optional absolute file path to a local image (supported for IMAGE type in local stdio mode).

login_customer_id.description: Optional manager customer ID to use as the login-customer-id header.

sitelink_link_text.description: Optional link text (required for SITELINK type).

structured_snippet_header.description: Optional structured snippet header category (required for STRUCTURED_SNIPPET type).

structured_snippet_values.description: Optional structured snippet list of values (required for STRUCTURED_SNIPPET type).

text_asset_text.description: Optional text content (required for TEXT type).

items.description: Key-value pair for custom tracking URL parameters.

url_custom_parameters.description: Optional custom parameters for tracking (list of {'key': ..., 'value': ...} dicts).

validate_only.description: If True (default), validates the request and returns proposed `change_items` and a `checksum` without creating the asset. If False, requires `checksum` from a prior `validate_only=True` call to commit the asset creation.

youtube_video_id.description: Optional YouTube 11-character video ID (required for YOUTUBE_VIDEO type).

tools.name: assets_create_asset
tools.title: Assets Create Asset

tools.description:
Uploads a video to YouTube natively via the Google Ads API.

Once a video has been uploaded, it can be used to create a video asset.
This operation executes via a FastMCP background task to gracefully handle large file uploads
(supported in local stdio mode only).
Once the upload finishes successfully, using the search tool and querying the `you_tube_video_upload`
resource matching the returned ID allows you to retrieve the YouTube Video ID and processing status.

Propose & Confirm Workflow (`validate_only` and `checksum`):
1. Call `upload_video_asset` with `validate_only=True` (the default). After validation passes, the tool returns structured `change_items` and a `checksum` without uploading the video.
2. Present the `change_items` to the user and wait for explicit user approval.
3. Only after user confirmation, call `upload_video_asset` with `validate_only=False` along with the exact same parameters and the `checksum` returned by the previous `validate_only=True` call.

checksum.description: Checksum of the validated operation returned by a prior `validate_only=True` call. Required when `validate_only=False`.

customer_id.description: Google Ads Customer ID (digits or hyphenated, e.g. '1234567890').

login_customer_id.description: Optional manager customer ID to use as the login-customer-id header.

validate_only.description: If True (default), validates the request and returns proposed `change_items` and a `checksum` without uploading the video. If False, requires `checksum` from a prior `validate_only=True` call to execute the video upload.

video_description.description: The description text attached to your YouTube video.

video_path.description: The absolute path on the local filesystem to the video file to be uploaded (local stdio mode only).

video_privacy.description: The privacy setting of the video on YouTube. Default is UNLISTED. Valid values are: PUBLIC, UNLISTED, PRIVATE. Note: PUBLIC is only allowed for brand channels.

video_title.description: The title you wish your video to have on YouTube.

youtube_channel_id.description: Optional. The ID of the YouTube channel the video will be uploaded to. If not provided, it will be uploaded to a Google-managed YouTube channel linked to your ads account.

tools.name: assets_upload_video_asset
tools.title: Assets Upload Video Asset

tools.description:
Returns ids of customers directly accessible by the user authenticating the call.

Use this tool first to discover available customer IDs if the user hasn't
provided one. Most other tools require a valid customer ID as input.
tools.name: customers_list_accessible_customers
tools.title: Customers List Accessible Customers

tools.description:
Manages associations between labels and Campaign, Customer, Ad Group, or Ad Group Criterion.

Supports CREATE and REMOVE operations.

Propose & Confirm Workflow (`validate_only` and `checksum`):
1. Call `manage_label_associations` with `validate_only=True` (the default). After validation passes, the tool returns structured `change_items` and a `checksum` without committing changes.
2. Present the `change_items` to the user and wait for explicit user approval.
3. Only after user confirmation, call `manage_label_associations` with `validate_only=False` along with the exact same parameters and the `checksum` returned by the previous `validate_only=True` call.

association_resource_name.description:
The full resource name of the association itself
(e.g., 'customers/123/campaignLabels/456~789'). Optional alternative for REMOVE
when `resource_id` and `label_id` are not provided.

association_type.description:
The type of resource being associated.
Must be 'CAMPAIGN', 'CUSTOMER', 'AD_GROUP', or 'AD_GROUP_CRITERION'.

checksum.description: Checksum of the validated operation returned by a prior `validate_only=True` call. Required when `validate_only=False`.

customer_id.description: Google Ads Customer ID (digits or hyphenated, e.g. '1234567890').

label_id.description: The ID of the Label (e.g., '789'). Required for CREATE.

login_customer_id.description: Optional manager customer ID to use as the login-customer-id header.

operation.description: The operation to perform. Must be 'CREATE' or 'REMOVE'.

resource_id.description:
The ID of the entity to associate (e.g., '456' for CAMPAIGN or AD_GROUP,
or composite '{ad_group_id}~{criterion_id}' such as '456~789' for AD_GROUP_CRITERION).
Optional for CUSTOMER (defaults to `customer_id`); required for CREATE on other types.

validate_only.description: If True (default), validates the request and returns proposed `change_items` and a `checksum` without mutating the association. If False, requires `checksum` from a prior `validate_only=True` call to commit the mutation.

tools.name: labels_manage_label_associations
tools.title: Labels Manage Label Associations

2. Present the `change_items` to the user and wait for explicit user approval.

background_color.description: Background color in HTML hex format (e.g., '#FF0000'). Optional.

checksum.description: Checksum of the validated operation returned by a prior `validate_only=True` call. Required when `validate_only=False`.

customer_id.description: Google Ads Customer ID (digits or hyphenated, e.g. '1234567890').

label_id.description: The ID of the label (e.g., '456'). Required for UPDATE and REMOVE.

login_customer_id.description: Optional manager customer ID to use as the login-customer-id header.

name.description: The name of the label. Required for CREATE, optional for UPDATE.

validate_only.description: If True (default), validates the request and returns proposed `change_items` and a `checksum` without mutating the label. If False, requires `checksum` from a prior `validate_only=True` call to commit the mutation.

tools.title: Labels Manage Labels

tools.description:
Retrieves the selectable, filterable, and sortable fields for a specific Google Ads resource,
including compatible metrics and segments.

Use this tool to find out which fields you can select, filter by, or sort by
when querying a specific resource (e.g., 'campaign', 'ad_group').
This tool also returns metrics and segments that can be selected with the resource.
Their names start with 'metrics.' and 'segments.' respectively.

Do not guess fields, you MUST use this tool to discover them before constructing a query for the
`search` tool.

The responses of this tool should be cached, as they don't change frequently.

login_customer_id.description: Optional manager customer ID to use as the login-customer-id header.

resource_name.description: The name of the Google Ads resource (e.g., 'campaign', 'ad_group').

tools.name: metadata_get_resource_metadata
tools.title: Metadata Get Resource Metadata

tools.description:
Spend, clicks, impressions, conversions and cost per conversion by
campaign for a date range, plus account totals.

Campaigns are sorted by cost (highest first). Totals cover the whole
account for the range, not only the rows on this page. Money is in the
account currency (not micros). Campaigns paused or removed during the
range are included, so totals are complete.

date_range.description: A preset range, or CUSTOM together with start_date and end_date.

include_zero_impressions.description: Also list campaigns with no impressions.

login_customer_id.description: Optional manager account ID for the login-customer-id header.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page (use `next_offset` from the previous call).

tools.name: reports_account_overview
tools.title: Reports Account Overview

tools.description:
Ad performance with ad strength and approval status, sorted by cost.

For responsive search ads, `include_assets=True` adds each headline and
description with its performance label (BEST, GOOD, LOW, LEARNING,
PENDING) where Google reports one, and its pin position.

ad_group_id.description: Only ads in this ad group (numeric ID).

campaign_id.description: Only ads in this campaign (numeric ID).

date_range.description: A preset range, or CUSTOM together with start_date and end_date.

limit.description: Ads per page (1-200; keep it small when include_assets is on).

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_ad_performance
tools.title: Reports Ad Performance

tools.description:
Month-to-date spend against each campaign budget, with a projection
for the full month.

One row per budget (a shared budget lists all its campaigns). For daily
budgets: `expected_mtd` = daily budget x elapsed days, `pace_pct` =
spend / expected, `projected_month` = spend / elapsed days x days in the
month, and `monthly_limit` = daily budget x 30.4 (the most Google
charges per month). `pace` is UNDER (<85 %), ON_TRACK or OVER (>115 %).
Uses the account time zone. Rows are sorted by month-to-date spend.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_budget_pacing
tools.title: Reports Budget Pacing

tools.description:
Recent changes to the account from `change_event`, newest first:
who changed what, when, with which tool, and which fields.

Google keeps change events for the last 30 days only.

days.description: How many days back to look (1-30).

include_values.description: Add the old and new value of each changed field.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

resource_type.description:
Optional filter such as CAMPAIGN, AD_GROUP, AD_GROUP_AD,
AD_GROUP_CRITERION, CAMPAIGN_BUDGET, CAMPAIGN_CRITERION or ASSET.

tools.name: reports_change_history
tools.title: Reports Change History

tools.description:
Lists conversion actions with status, primary/secondary,
include-in-conversions, counting, attribution and whether the action
is imported from GA4.

With `include_stats=True` adds conversions and all conversions for the
last 30 days, so actions that stopped recording stand out.

include_stats.description: Add last-30-day conversion counts per action.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_conversion_actions
tools.title: Reports Conversion Actions

tools.description:
Performance by location, sorted by cost, with location names.

`view="geographic"` (`geographic_view`) reports the location that
triggered the ad, split by location type: LOCATION_OF_PRESENCE (people
in the area) or AREA_OF_INTEREST (people searching for it), so a place
can appear twice. `view="user_location"` (`user_location_view`) reports
where users physically were, with `targeted` telling whether that
location was targeted.

date_range.description: A preset range, or CUSTOM together with start_date and end_date.

level.description: Location granularity: country, region, city or most_specific.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_geo_performance
tools.title: Reports Geo Performance

tools.description:
Keyword performance with Quality Score and its three components,
sorted by cost.

Quality Score components are BELOW_AVERAGE, AVERAGE or ABOVE_AVERAGE:
`expected_ctr`, `ad_relevance` and `landing_page_experience`. Quality
Score is the current value, not a value for the date range, and is left
out when Google has too little data. `cpc_bid` is the effective max CPC.

date_range.description: A preset range, or CUSTOM together with start_date and end_date.

include_zero_impressions.description: Also list keywords with no impressions.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_keyword_performance
tools.title: Reports Keyword Performance

tools.description:
Performance by landing page, sorted by cost.

By default groups by the final URL set on the ad (`landing_page_view`).
With `expanded=True` groups by the URL users actually landed on, after
URL expansion and tracking parameters (`expanded_landing_page_view`).
Includes the mobile-friendly click rate and the landing page speed score
(1-10) where Google reports them.

date_range.description: A preset range, or CUSTOM together with start_date and end_date.

expanded.description: Group by the expanded (actual) landing page URL.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_landing_page_performance
tools.title: Reports Landing Page Performance

tools.description:
Lists Google's recommendations for the account with their estimated
impact (potential minus base metrics for the week).

Read only: this tool does not apply or dismiss anything. Budget and
keyword recommendations include their details (current vs recommended
budget; keyword text, match type and suggested CPC).

campaign_id.description: Only recommendations for this campaign (numeric ID).

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_recommendations_list
tools.title: Reports Recommendations List

tools.description:
Search terms that triggered ads, with match type and a
`suggested_negative` flag, sorted by cost.

`suggested_negative` is a simple heuristic, not a decision: a term is
flagged when it has 0 conversions, at least `negative_min_clicks`
clicks, costs at least `negative_min_cost` (when given) and is not
already excluded. Review the terms before adding negatives.

date_range.description: A preset range, or CUSTOM together with start_date and end_date.

min_impressions.description: Minimum impressions for a term to be listed.

negative_min_clicks.description: Clicks needed before a non-converting term is flagged.

negative_min_cost.description: Optional minimum cost (account currency) before flagging.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_search_terms_report
tools.title: Reports Search Terms Report

tools.description:
Search terms and keywords that cost more than `min_cost` and brought
zero conversions in the date range, sorted by cost (highest first).

Use it to find negative keyword and pausing candidates. "Zero
conversions" uses the `conversions` metric, so it depends on which
conversion actions count as primary.

date_range.description: A preset range, or CUSTOM together with start_date and end_date.

limit.description: Rows per page for each list (1-200).

min_cost.description: Only rows that cost more than this, in account currency (not micros).

offset.description: Row offset for the next page.

tools.name: reports_wasted_spend
tools.title: Reports Wasted Spend

tools.description:
Returns the active safety settings: read-only mode, the customer
allow-list and the budget, bid and operation limits.

Call this before proposing a change to learn which limits apply. Money
limits are in each account's own currency units, not micros.
tools.name: safety_get_safety_settings
tools.title: Safety Get Safety Settings

tools.description:
Lists recent reversible changes made through this server, newest first.

Use it to find the `change_id` to pass to `undo_change`. Only field
updates that the safety layer could snapshot (statuses, budgets, bids,
bidding targets) are listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of changes to return (1-100).

tools.name: safety_list_changes
tools.title: Safety List Changes

tools.description:
Reverts a change made through this server by restoring the "before"
values that were saved when the change was committed.

Works for simple field updates: campaign, ad group, keyword and ad
status; campaign budget amounts; CPC bids; tCPA / tROAS targets. Use
`list_changes` to find the `change_id`.

Before reverting, the tool reads the current values. If any field was
changed again after the original change, the undo is refused unless
`force=True`. Budget and bid limits apply to the undo as to any change.

Propose & Confirm Workflow (`validate_only` and `checksum`):
1. Call `undo_change` with `validate_only=True` (the default). The tool
   validates the reverse operations with the API and returns
   `change_items` and a `checksum` without changing anything.
2. Present the `change_items` to the user and wait for explicit approval.
3. Call `undo_change` again with `validate_only=False`, the same
   parameters and the `checksum`.

change_id.description:
The change ID returned when the change was committed
(e.g. '20260101T120000Z-1a2b3c4d').

checksum.description:
Checksum from the previous `validate_only=True` call.
Required when `validate_only=False`.

force.description:
Revert even if a field was changed again after the original
change. The fields are set to the saved "before" values.

login_customer_id.description:
Optional manager customer ID; defaults to the one
used for the original change.

validate_only.description: If True (default), only proposes the undo.

tools.name: safety_undo_change
tools.title: Safety Undo Change
